items.hyp: Ebintu bingi mu kaweefube ow'omulimu ogwa waggulu, kijja kuba kya Kodak ne Fuji, nga bwe kityo.

items.hyp: Oluvannyuma lw'okutunda empya ez'okukola ebintu ebyafulumira mu Mozambique, Lebanon, Morocco ne Ethiopia, kino kino kino kino kino kye kireetawo mu Uganda.

items.hyp: CinemArena mu Uganda kweyongera okukola mu kunoonyereza kwa kusanyusa abantu okutuusa nga kati kyetaagisa okuba n'ekitongole ekikolwa Amakula.
items.ref: Ekisaawe ky'ebya ffirimu mu Uganda kyetooloolera ku kukyusa mbeera z'abantu, okusiima kugende eri Italian cooperation ne Amakula Film.

items.hyp: Kati bangi bwe buli muntu mu Gulu, ate nga kati kati kati kye kisoboka okukola eky'okuzimba ebintu ebitali bimu okubaako.

items.hyp: Abantu abo mu Gulu balina ekiragiro kya nnina okutuusa ku kiba nga kiba nga kiba nga kkumi.

items.hyp: Marco Ballerini omukulembeze w'ekitongole kya projezetwawo yagamba nti okukola kwe kuba kuba abantu basobola okukola ennyimba zirina okukola enkola ez'omutindo ogwa wansi.

items.hyp: Baali baagamba nti abamu ku b'abalala baali baakola mu kibiina kya UPDF.

items.hyp: Mu Okitobba 2008 abakungu ba kampuni zaabwe baali bakubiriza okukkiriza ensonga zaabulira abo abaali bavunaanyizibwa aba ADF abaali bayingizibwa gavumenti okuva mu kubba abo abaali bavunaanyizibwa.

items.hyp: Abayeekera abo abali mu ADF baagamba gavumenti okukola ebintu ne bataagulira mu nteekateeka.
items.ref: Abaaliko abayeekera ba Allied Democratic Forces baalumizizza gavumenti okubakozesa n'ebasuulawo nga tebasasudde.

items.hyp: Bbomu ezaabwatukira mu Kampala nga Jjulaayi 11 zaali zikola okuba n'ab'ekitongole ekikola ku ADF ne Somalia abatujju aba Al-Shabaab.
